message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine Tempo features a large central figure in dark tactical gear, including a helmet, goggles, and a black face mask. This person is positioned over a grey, circular surface filled with several round holes. The figure holds two large, red-headed mallets with light grey handles. One mallet is raised high, while the other is positioned as if about to strike a hole.

Emerging from three separate holes are smaller figures. On the left, a person wearing a blue head covering and black face mask holds a black handgun. On the right, a person in a tan vest and black balaclava holds several sticks of dynamite bound together. A third figure is partially visible in the center-left.

At the top, the word "TEMPO" is written in large, grey, serif letters, with "50 Tahun!" in a light script font below. Bold white text to the left reads "GENERASI TERORIS MILENIAL," followed by smaller white text. Additional white text is at the top left and right. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner, alongside date and price information.
